_comment: NETHER WART, which is the one output here that is alive.
It is a FUNGUS, and fungal spores survive being cooked and buried far better than anything
else in a dump - which is the whole reason this chain is defensible where a chain ending in
a ghast tear would not be. Separating, because the machine is picking viable spores out of a
mass that is mostly not: the byproduct is ordinary organic muck, the same material the
overworld's compost tier already runs on.
Why it matters: wart otherwise comes only from a fortress. This gives a player who mines a
route to brewing without raiding one, which is the mod's own thesis - salvage instead of
adventure - and it pairs with the soul sand that Slag Rubble already yields, since wart will
COUNT IS 1, and must be (owner, 2026-08-19): a GUI-less machine cannot take N > 1 inputs to
make an output. This was 4. A machine with no GUI and no Container has nothing to open and
nothing to take back out, so a remainder the recipe cannot use is invisible and unrecoverable -
and a remainder is the NORMAL state, because the pull streams hand their scrap out one item at
Ticks and energy are unchanged on purpose. An operation already made one output, so the cost
per output in time and power is the same as before; the only thing that moves is the material
ratio, and that is #36's, whose dial is the drop weight.
